items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: They never stopped Bill Robinson, he was a big star. They put the red carpet out for him.

ctx.x: They never stopped Bill Robinson, he was a big star. They put the red carpet out for him. But the porter it was too much pressure, ordinary layman out there/ carrying them bricks and working, / he couldn't stand that. It was a regular Broadway production we put on, they could afford that. Stars, from the Ziegfeld show, and madames, all the big madames come up there.
How was the -- how did it come about that you all decided to go to Europe.
